description: Turns triggers into a melody: fifteen inputs each move a running pitch up, down or alternately up and down by a fixed interval, and the total comes out as a control voltage

params.text: Sets how many steps make an octave, 4 to 24; at twelve a step is a semitone and at any other setting the intervals fall between the usual notes
Sets how wide a band the pitch may cover before the edge behaviour applies; the number shown is the whole band in volts and the pitch is held within half of it either side of 0V
Chooses what happens when the pitch leaves the band: in the lower position it is wrapped round to the other end, and in the upper position the pitch and the running total are reset to zero

inputs.text: A trigger here moves the running pitch up by one step of the scale
A trigger here moves the running pitch down by one step of the scale
A trigger here moves the running pitch by one step, in the opposite direction from the last time this jack was used
A trigger here moves the running pitch up by two steps of the scale
A trigger here moves the running pitch down by two steps of the scale
A trigger here moves the running pitch by two steps, in the opposite direction from the last time this jack was used
A trigger here moves the running pitch up by five steps of the scale
A trigger here moves the running pitch down by five steps of the scale
A trigger here moves the running pitch by five steps, in the opposite direction from the last time this jack was used
A trigger here moves the running pitch up by seven steps of the scale
A trigger here moves the running pitch down by seven steps of the scale
A trigger here moves the running pitch by seven steps, in the opposite direction from the last time this jack was used
A trigger here moves the running pitch up by twelve steps of the scale
A trigger here moves the running pitch down by twelve steps of the scale
A trigger here moves the running pitch by twelve steps, in the opposite direction from the last time this jack was used
A trigger here puts the running pitch back to 0V
A trigger here sets all five alternating jacks back to moving upward on their next use

outputs.text: The running pitch, one volt per octave once the scale knob is set to twelve
A one millisecond trigger whenever any of the fifteen step jacks fires
A one millisecond trigger whenever the pitch reaches the edge of the band and is wrapped or reset

notes: The scale is microtonal at every setting other than twelve, so a quantiser after this module is usually wanted
